description: The project's living feature inventory (what exists in the codebase, AI-maintained): name, area, status, and summary per feature. Returns a page: { features, offset, limit, hasMore }. The default page is deliberately small for agent context cost, so page with offset while hasMore is true (or raise limit, max 500) when the inventory is bigger.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Default 0; page while hasMore is true

title: List features
